articles.title: AMH Announces Distributions
articles.summary: AMH (NYSE: AMH) (the "Company"), a leading large-scale integrated owner, operator and developer of single-family rental homes, today announced that the Board of Trustees declared a dividend of $0.33 per share on the Company's common shares for the third quarter of 2026.
